Contract ManageItemCRUDService::queryItem(barcode: Integer): Item {
	definition:
		obs: Set(Item) = Item.allInstance()->select(o|o.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		obs.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		let foundItem: Item in
		foundItem.oclIsNew() and
		Item.allInstance()->includes(foundItem) and
		result = foundItem
}
